    Proposition 12.5: weights, and I₀ = I #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "Giving ε internal degree −q and the opposite weight makes the corner deformation homogeneous of the required degree and weight. […] In characteristic two, each residual line k[p_i] of Proposition 6.1 has weight χ_i and is now in the image, so HH²(A₀)_{χ_i} ≠ 0 and I₀ = I."

    For a mesh weight W, the weight-χ part of a category cocycle (CatCocycle.wproj) is again a cocycle of the same internal degree; its mesh value is the relative weight-χ part of the original one, and its corner μ has character χ (catMu_hasChar). Hence every correction tuple of relative weight χ is Ψ[μ] for a cocycle μ of character χ (Ψc_surjective_char), and a row with nonzero cokernel class gives a cocycle of the row's character which is not a coboundary (exists_not_cobdry): I ⊆ I₀. The inclusion I₀ ⊆ I is Proposition 7.6 (Ψc_mem_rowSpan_char).
